global_rules.current_rule: Fail closed: never report success, release custody, or add a fallback unless the modeled or real boundary actually completed.
Production mesh deployment is transactional: verified stage-only, exact-artifact qualification capture, then promotion with that capture.
One serialized owner controls each radio, operation, queue record, and terminal transition; asynchronous callbacks must carry a generation and bounded deadline.

issues.current_rule: Do not claim established-event reset recovery: a relay reset after event ownership is established can still terminate repair as stale.
Do not use a long lossy campaign as liveness proof if any fixed telemetry ring truncated.
issues.source_fingerprint: Long lossy busy-line campaigns can deliver every transaction

issues.current_rule: Stage 1 paired HIL still needs raw DS-TWR geometry and plausible RANGE_OK evidence before qualification.
issues.source_fingerprint: paired HIL still lacks raw DS-TWR geometry

issues.current_rule: ThreadSanitizer cannot run in this host environment; use deterministic interleavings plus ASan and UBSan and do not claim TSan evidence.
issues.source_fingerprint: ThreadSanitizer binaries compile on this host but abort before `main`

issues.current_rule: Use native_sim/native/64 for the persistence fixture because this host lacks 32-bit libc headers.
This pyOCD has no list --json support; parse the plain probe table and match the full probe ID.
issues.source_fingerprint: This host's pyOCD `list` command does not support `--json`

issues.current_rule: pyOCD pre-reset selects connection behavior but does not reset an already-running target; perform and verify an explicit reset when fresh boot identity is required.
issues.source_fingerprint: `pyocd rtt -M pre-reset` selects the connection sequence

issues.current_rule: A gateway running pre-fix firmware may retain an orphaned survey; recover it with the provisioning abort-survey command.
issues.source_fingerprint: unprobed gateway can retain a pre-fix orphaned survey indefinitely

issues.current_rule: Use indexed preflight or bounded chunks; a single large tool output can omit the middle of the issue ledger.
issues.source_fingerprint: Concatenating hundreds of issue-ledger lines into one tool call

issues.current_rule: Treat each current changelog plus the Mesh Contract as present truth until inherited contradictory body sections are flattened in a dedicated documentation stage.
issues.source_fingerprint: current architecture and protocol documents still retain inherited body text
